name: Bezeq The Israel Telecommunication Corp. Ltd
summary: Bezeq The Israel Telecommunication Corp. Ltd provides communications services to business and private customers in Israel. The company operates through Domestic Fixed Communications; Cellular Communications; Internet Services, International Communication, and ICT Solutions for Businesses; and Television and communication segments. The company offers telephony services, including basic telephony services on the home telephone line; ancillary services, such as voice mail and caller ID; national numbering services; and internet access infrastructure services.
